content: A weak king rules over a cobbled-together kingdom that's already coming apart at the seams. Various heroes and villains compete and scheme to claim the throne. A new challenger rises up from across the sea, full of vengeance and bloodlust... If that sounds like the premise of Game of Thrones, well, that's because it is, but it's also the set-up for Prime Video's thrilling new action drama from one of the 21st-century's most successful (and underappreciated) showrunners.
